title: Qualification of a Building for a Tier of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Qualification of a Building for a Tier

## Rule

A tier of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions is quoted only for a building whose data can actually feed it. The site must carry at least the tier's minimum number of interval meters, counted as meters already installed or included in the same quote, and the meter kinds must be among those the tier reads. A tier whose automation plan requirement is set is quoted only where the same building holds an automation service plan in active or pending renewal status, because the tier's analytics read the controls data. A tier whose site survey requirement is set is quoted only when an energy site survey for that building is recorded as completed in the office records. Where the building meets no tier's data requirements, the desk offers meter installation as a project first and quotes the subscription afterwards. The tier's minimum meter count, whether it requires an automation plan, whether it requires a survey and the fee of the survey are the figures fixed for that tier.

## The three tests and what decides each

| Test | Set by | Decided from |
|---|---|---|
| Minimum interval meters | the tier's minimum meter figure | meters already installed at the site plus meters included in the same quote |
| Automation service plan at the building | the tier's automation plan requirement | the company's own records of the automation service plan at the same building: it must stand in active or pending renewal status |
| Energy site survey completed | the tier's survey requirement | the office's intake records: a survey for that building recorded as completed |

Each of the last two tests is decided on the company's system records for the same building, read before the quote is made; a caller's statement that a plan exists or a survey was done does not stand in for the record.

## Basis Q&A

**A building has 3 interval meters installed and the quote includes 2 more. Does it meet a minimum of 4?** Yes: meters included in the same quote count toward the minimum, so the site carries 5.

**The automation plan at the building is suspended. Is a tier with the automation plan requirement quoted?** No. Only active or pending renewal status satisfies the test.

**A survey was done but the intake record shows it received rather than completed.** The test is not met; the survey must be recorded as completed.

**The building meets no tier's data requirements.** Meter installation is offered as a project first, and the subscription is quoted afterwards.
